posts.title: Vim alternatives on OpenBSD
posts.description: I’ve been using vi like forever. I was never an Emacs guy and I can’t stand nano and alike. The only other editors I use are Mousepad and Vim .

posts.title: M715q power usage and the BSDes
posts.description: Following previous post where using M720q as a desktop machine was considered not that good, someone on the Fediverse pointed me to the AMD versions of ThinkCentre. Having noticed that ATI/AMD/Radeon GPU do seem to work pretty well on OpenBSD, I got a refurbished ThinkCentre M715q and had a look at it.

posts.title: What about ThinkCentre M710q, M720q and *BSD
posts.description: Thanks to being subscribed to self-hosting and homelab feeds, I yet again was trapped by compulsive buying and collector’s impulse while browsing the local refurb marketplaces. This may end now. Until then, here’s a quick look at ThinkCentre M710q and M720q on various BSD systems.
